posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Helly everyone!
With permission of TheRealFusion, I am reposting his RPG Maker work here for you guys to access it.
If you are still missing something of his work, let me know, I am in contact with him.
Remember:
Author of these tilesets is
TheRealFusion.
He is all cool with editing, reposting, commercial use, just remember to follow the terms.
Since some of these are edits of
RPG Maker MV resources
, you must own that one.
